title: Colour removal with no PO number or date, buyer has two open orders of the same style
subject: BW-TS-204 – drop Coral
body:
Hi Karthik,

For the BW-TS-204 tees, please drop Sunwashed Coral completely and keep only Heather Charcoal, 2,400 pcs as now. Our planners have pulled Coral from the range.

Thanks,
Megan
Brightwater Apparel Inc.
